# Agentic Multimodal Demo

This folder contains a multimodal agent demo notebook and supporting artifacts.

## Contents

* `agentic-multimodal.ipynb` — the main demo notebook
* `artifacts/` — generated output files produced by the notebook

## Purpose

The demo explores agentic workflows that integrate vision and language processing.
It is intended as an experimental showcase of multimodal reasoning and task execution.

## Notes

* Open `agentic-multimodal.ipynb` to run the demo.
* Do not commit generated files from `artifacts/` unless they are intentionally preserved.
